reasoning_traces.think:
PageRank unifies three dualities: (1) Random walk vs. linear algebra, where the stationary distribution equals the principal eigenvector of the transition matrix; (2) Local degree centrality vs. global eigenvector centrality, resolving the chicken-and-egg problem of mutual reinforcement; (3) Teleportation vs. diffusion, balancing exploration versus exploitation. Failure occurs when graphs are too sparse, leading to disconnected components and loss of uniqueness in the stationary distribution.
